name: EZ Promotion & Apparel, LLC
old_description: Call us to speak with our team. We take the time to get to know you and what your promo needs are.
about:
EZ Promotion & Apparel, LLC operates from Watertown, Wisconsin. The company is organized as a limited liability company; no founding year, founder names, or specific ownership designations such as veteran- or woman-owned are disclosed in the available sources.

The firm acts as a promotional-products distributor and branding partner. It sources apparel, accessories, drinkware, and other merchandise, then applies custom decoration and manages the entire fulfillment chain. Core services include building and hosting branded online swag shops with Shopify integration, handling inventory-free order processing, and shipping worldwide. The company advertises a 2–3 day turnaround on swag-shop orders and emphasizes a no-upfront-cost model for its storefront clients.

Clients span education, healthcare, and general corporate sectors. Concrete examples include an elementary-school fundraiser needing T-shirts and incentive prizes, a medical practice ordering custom scrub tops, and businesses running trade-show giveaways, direct-mail campaigns, and sponsorship activations. The company also supports remote-employee engagement programs and customer-appreciation gift boxes.

The stated differentiator is an "EZ guarantee" that promises to return clients' time by delivering customized product recommendations after a brief discovery process. Speed, a hands-off inventory model, and integrated e-commerce setup are presented as the primary value drivers.

name: Eagle Point Solar
old_description: Solar Projects for Agriculture, Commercial, Residential, Municipal, Utility and Academic Industries
about:
Eagle Point Solar is based in Dubuque, Iowa, and serves customers across Iowa, Illinois, and Wisconsin. The company operates as a turnkey solar contractor, handling projects from initial design through installation and ongoing support.

The firm provides end-to-end solar energy solutions, including site assessment, system design, engineering, permitting, rebate processing, construction, and commissioning. Its Solar Journey process covers residential rooftops, agricultural arrays, commercial and municipal buildings, academic campuses, and utility-scale installations. The company also integrates battery backup systems and offers a dedicated service and support team for post-installation maintenance.

Eagle Point Solar works with a range of public and private sector clients. Municipal projects include the Green County Government Services Building, the City of La Crosse Municipal Service Center, City of Asbury, and City of Sun Prairie. Commercial and industrial clients include Nortera and Wired Production Group. Residential installations feature the Moler, Kramer, Sikemma, and Parkin residences. The company also serves agricultural and academic customers.

The company emphasizes a turnkey approach that manages incentives, grants, and equipment depreciation for customers. Its stated differentiators are a team, a tested process, and proven results, with particular expertise in navigating solar incentives and energy grants to reduce project costs.

name: Earth Ranch
old_description: ? Our team at Earth Ranch specializes in helping brands bring high-quality snacks to market. Contact us below or call us directly to discuss your project.
about:
Earth Ranch operates from Jackson, Wisconsin, as a U.S.-based organic snack manufacturer and food co-packer. The company specializes in clean-label dehydrated snacks, sprouted nuts, clusters, and trail mixes, serving both emerging and established brands through private label manufacturing, co-packing, and product development services.

Its product range spans trail mixes, clusters and bites, granolas, dehydrated fruit bars, functional fruit-based bars, sprouted seeds and nuts, crackers, and other functional snacks. The facility is peanut-free and offers packaging options including gusseted pouches, pillow packs, and bar wrappers. Minimum order quantities run from 10,000 to 20,000 units depending on the product.

Earth Ranch works with brands across the organic, plant-based, gluten-free, non-GMO, keto, paleo, vegan, and kosher snack categories. Customers include companies seeking a co-manufacturing partner for dehydrated foods or a private label producer to bring custom formulations to market, with the option to select from a ready-to-ship catalog or develop new products.

The company emphasizes a value-added dehydration approach and a clean-label philosophy, highlighting attributes such as added protein, grain-free, and exotic flavors. Its differentiation rests on a peanut-free facility, a broad portfolio of dietary certifications and claims, and a development process that moves ideas from concept to shelf-ready products.

name: East Lake Axle
old_description: FREE 2-Day Shipping on all orders over $62 within the contiguous continental US.
about:
East Lake Axle operates from Oldsmar, Florida, where it was established to supply high-performance driveline components for off-road vehicles at economical prices. The company eliminates middlemen by purchasing in volume directly from factories around the world, passing on the benefits of quality control, design engineering, and purchasing power to customers.

The company distributes a wide range of parts for ATVs, UTVs, golf carts, and snowmobiles, including complete transmissions, differentials, axles, ball joints, wheel bearings, belts, carriers, primary clutches, wheel hubs, shocks, U-joints, knuckles, and seat covers. All products are backed by a two-year fault-free warranty, and orders over $62 receive free two-day shipping within the contiguous United States.

East Lake Axle serves off-road enthusiasts and repair shops looking for replacement driveline components. Its catalog covers major off-road vehicle types, and the company emphasizes direct-to-consumer pricing through its global supply chain.

The business differentiates itself by cutting out intermediaries, offering factory-direct pricing, an warranty, and fast fulfillment from its Florida facility.

name: East Penn Manufacturing Co. (Deka Batteries)
old_description: East Penn Manufacturing, one of the world's largest battery makers, operates a battery finishing and distribution plant in Temple, Texas that has undergone multiple expansions, including a $110 million investment announced in 2026.
about:
East Penn Manufacturing, a private, family-owned company, was founded in 1946 by Air Force veteran DeLight Breidegam Jr. and his father, DeLight Sr., in a one-room creamery in Bowers, Pennsylvania. The business began by rebuilding used batteries to meet post-war demand from returning GIs. In 1947, Karl Gasche joined as a partner, and the Deka brand—derived from "DeLight" and "Karl"—was born. Today the company operates a major battery finishing and distribution plant in Temple, Texas, alongside what it describes as the world's largest single-site lead battery manufacturing facility.

East Penn produces lead-acid batteries for automotive, industrial, motive power, transportation, and reserve power (UPS, telecommunications, renewable energy) applications. Its product portfolio spans 515 designs, supported by vertically integrated operations that include wire and cable manufacturing, battery accessories, and custom solutions. The company reports over 10,500 full-time employees worldwide and operates through divisions such as Motive Power, Transportation, Reserve Power, and Wire & Cable, as well as subsidiaries including Navitas Systems (lithium technology), MK Battery, East Penn Canada, and East Penn International.

Customers span automotive OEMs, material-handling equipment makers, commercial truck fleets, telecommunications providers, and renewable-energy integrators. The company has been recognized by Honda and John Deere for supplier sustainability, and its batteries serve applications ranging from lift trucks and commercial vehicles to critical backup power for data centers and outside plant.

The founding principle of putting customers and employees first remains central, reinforced by an integrated quality and environmental management system. East Penn emphasizes pollution prevention, waste reduction, and compliance with global standards, holding multiple internationally recognized certifications. A $110 million expansion announced for the Texas facility in 2026 underscores continued investment in domestic capacity.

name: Eatem Foods Co
old_description: ADM connects harvest to home, utilizing our farmer partnerships, global transportation capabilities, market insights, and innovation to deliver solutions today and tomorrow.
about:
Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, ADM operates as a global agricultural supply chain manager and processor. The company purchases crops from tens of thousands of farmers worldwide, moves them through an integrated network of elevators, trucks, railcars, barges, and ships, and transforms them at 325 production sites into ingredients for food, feed, fuel, and industrial uses. A founding year and original founders are not disclosed in its public materials; the business is a publicly traded corporation.

ADM’s core activities span crop origination, transportation logistics, and large-scale ingredient manufacturing. Its human nutrition portfolio includes colors, flavors, proteins, and texturants for beverages, baked goods, and supplements. Animal nutrition covers complete feeds, premixes, and additives for livestock, aquaculture, and pets. The industrial biosolutions segment produces biofuels, bioplastics, and bio-based chemicals. In 2024 the company moved 140 million metric tons of agricultural products — roughly 5% of global trade — and generated $85 billion in revenue with 44,000 employees across six continents.

Customers range from multinational food and beverage brands to feed mills, pet food manufacturers, and industrial companies seeking renewable alternatives. ADM serves the human nutrition, animal nutrition, pet nutrition, and industrial biosolutions markets, with specific applications in beverages, bakery, dietary supplements, aquaculture feed, biodiesel, personal care, and home care products.

The company emphasizes its farmer partnerships, regenerative agriculture programs, and precision fermentation capabilities as differentiators. It positions itself as a leader in business-driven sustainability, leveraging its unmatched transportation network and manufacturing footprint to connect harvest to home while supporting grower livelihoods.

name: Ebbesen Woodworking
old_description: Outdoor Bars, Workbenches & Backyard Builds • Warrenville, IL
about:
Ebbesen Woodworking operates from Warrenville, Illinois, as a one-person artisan workshop specializing in handcrafted outdoor bars and custom workbenches. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or founder’s name, but presents itself as a dedicated solo craftsmanship operation built around direct client communication and on-site installation.

The shop produces a curated line of backyard bars — including models such as The Main Spot, The Eyre Square, The Dartford, The Spanish Arch, The Sidekick, The Forest Hill, and The Storehouse — alongside three standard workbench sizes (8×2, 8×3, 8×4 feet) offered in fixed or mobile configurations. All pieces are fabricated in-house using pressure-treated lumber and weather-ready finishes, with a process that moves from design consultation through fabrication, delivery, and final setup. The workshop also accepts custom dimensions and accessory planning for both product lines.

The customer base consists of residential homeowners seeking permanent outdoor entertaining structures or durable shop furniture. Projects referenced in the company’s gallery include corner-friendly bars, grill-integrated layouts, dart-wing additions, and combined bar-storage footprints, as well as custom workbenches with pegboard, outlets, and varied depths. The service area covers the Warrenville region, with the company coordinating installation directly.

Ebbesen Woodworking emphasizes a single-craftsman model as its differentiator: every project is handled from first sketch to final install by the same builder, ensuring consistent fitment and direct communication. The company positions its straightforward quoting, builder-guided finish selection, and focus on real-world outdoor durability as the reasons clients choose its builds over mass-produced alternatives.

about:
Eco Plastic Products of Delaware operates from Wilmington, Delaware, where it collects and recycles plastic waste into durable outdoor products. The organization’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company accepts clean, dry Polyethylene (#2 and #4) and Polypropylene (#5) plastics — such as bags, bottle caps, and containers — and transforms them into 100% recycled plastic park benches and tables. To date, it has diverted 160,790 pounds of plastic from landfills and waterways. Products are described as UV-protected, weather-resistant, and maintenance-free. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The organization sells its recycled plastic furniture directly as consumer goods, targeting individuals and groups seeking sustainable outdoor seating. Concrete customer types or industry verticals are not specified beyond the general consumer market.

Its stated mission is to reinvent how plastic waste is viewed by turning discarded material into purposeful products while fostering education, inspiring community action, and providing opportunities to people of all abilities.

name: EcoBuild LLC
old_description: EcoBuild specializes in the design, installation and support of residential and commercial capacity solar panel systems.
about:
EcoBuild LLC is based in Zachary, Louisiana, and serves the greater Baton Rouge area. The company was founded to bring energy-efficient building solutions and renewable energy services together, helping property owners make smarter investments in their buildings.

EcoBuild designs, installs, services, and maintains solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, backup generators, and energy-efficiency upgrades for residential and commercial clients. The firm works with equipment lines including Tesla Powerwall (as a certified installer), Generac gas and solar backup generators, Enphase energy storage systems, and Sol-Ark hybrid inverters. Additional offerings include EV charging stations, solar canopies, and commercial construction services. Project scoping begins with free satellite imagery analysis followed by onsite consultation.

The company serves homeowners, commercial property owners, and new-construction projects across Louisiana. Its customer base includes residential clients seeking lower utility bills and storm resilience, as well as businesses looking to upgrade facilities with turnkey renewable solutions such as solar PV, EV chargers, and integrated whole-house generators.

EcoBuild differentiates itself through a "Whole Building" approach developed in partnership with Thermo-Guard Industrial, which addresses heat, humidity, and hurricane hardening alongside energy savings. The firm emphasizes education-first consulting, 24-hour service for installed systems, and a licensed, bonded, and insured workforce with decades of construction experience.

name: Edco Industries/Plastic Injection Molding
old_description: The purpose of our mission statement is to provide direction and balance when committing a team of one or many to the growth and longevity of Edco Industries.
about:
Edco Industries operates from Bridgeport, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1978 as a family-owned and operated business. The company traces its roots to the Szalan family, with John T. Szalan, a plastics engineer and graduate of Central Connecticut State University, now serving as president after growing up in the business. His mother, Anna Marie Szalan, has overseen purchasing, accounting, quoting, and operations since the founding, providing more than 46 years of leadership.

The shop provides full-service injection molding, covering design collaboration, tooling construction using aluminum or steel molds, molding on state-of-the-art equipment, and a four-step quality inspection process. Secondary operations include hot stamping, ultrasonic welding, decorating, EMI coating, 3D printing, fastener application, and assembly. Production scales from low to high volumes, though the facility size and total headcount are not disclosed.

Edco serves a diverse range of industries with high-performance plastic components, but the company does not list specific sectors on its website. Its customer base includes businesses requiring ITAR-compliant manufacturing and those seeking HUBZone-certified suppliers.

The company’s stated differentiators are its ISO 9001:2015 certification, ITAR registration, SBA HUBZone certification, and recognition as a top woman-owned business in Connecticut. Its mission emphasizes superior quality, competitive pricing, on-time delivery, and 100 percent customer satisfaction as the foundation for profitability.
